race.title: Best Odds On The Betfair Exchange Handicap Hurdle (GBB Race)
race.verdict: KOCKTAIL BLEU looks the one to beat following his encouraging fourth in a loaded renewal of the Silver Trophy on return. Give It To Me Oj stands out as the main danger ahead of Smokeringinthedark , who was progressing steadily when runner-up here in the spring. KOCKTAIL BLEU (FR) GIVE IT TO ME OJ SMOKERINGINTHEDARK (IRE)
